description: LEGACY_CIPHER_ALGORITHM "AES/CTR/NoPadding" is retained for backward compatibility and provides confidentiality without authentication (no MAC/AEAD), permitting undetected ciphertext tampering.
authEngineVersion=1 sets unsafeSkipFinalHkdf=true, omitting a final HKDF round and weakening key derivation; v2 is the secure default.
CIPHER_ALGORITHM "AES/CTR/NoPadding" provides confidentiality only; payloads are not authenticated, enabling potential undetected tampering.
DIGEST="DIGEST-MD5" selects the SASL DIGEST-MD5 mechanism, which relies on the broken MD5 hash function (IETF deprecated in RFC 6331) and remains exposed when SASL fallback is engaged.
Hardcoded SASL realm "default" is not configurable; reduces cross-realm distinguishability and complicates secret-scope isolation.
credulousTrustStoreManagers() returns a TrustManager whose checkClient/ServerTrusted are no-ops, accepting any X.509 certificate including self-signed.
trustStoreManagers() returns credulous (no-op) trust manager when the configured truststore is null or missing, silently disabling TLS peer verification.
engine.setNeedClientAuth(false) is hardcoded in createSSLEngine, preventing mTLS even when servers configure trust stores for client cert verification.
executeAndGetOutput(idPath :: "-Gn" :: username :: Nil) passes an unvalidated username as a positional argv element to id; a username starting with "-" is interpreted as an id option.
addFilters wires servlet filters only when MASTER_REST_SERVER_FILTERS is set; with no filter configured, REST submission accepts driver submissions on port 6066 unauthenticated.
PickleSerializer.loads uses pickle.loads on stream bytes; untrusted pickled data can execute arbitrary code on deserialization. Mitigated by Py4J authenticated socket.
CloudPickleSerializer.loads delegates to cloudpickle.loads which executes arbitrary code from untrusted bytes; rely on Py4J auth and transport encryption.
cloudpickle.loads re-exports pickle.loads, deserializing arbitrary Python objects; a peer who can influence the byte stream can execute arbitrary code.
Bundled Apache Hive 2.3.10 carries multiple CVEs across the 2.3.x line affecting metastore/Thrift surfaces, including HiveServer2 CookieSigner signature exposure (CVE-2024-23945) and authz gaps.
commons-lang 2.6 is end-of-life (2014); retained for Hive UDF compatibility. EOL libraries do not receive security patches. Track and minimize transitive exposure.
X-Frame-Options ALLOW-FROM <uri> built by string concat from spark.ui.allowFramingFrom; admin-set, but no validation against CR/LF — could enable header injection.
